manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Generate a polished, Microsoft-Fluent-styled PowerPoint (.pptx) deck from a JSON spec of slides and layouts.
manifest.name: @kody-w/microsoft_deck_studio_agent

output_path.description: Absolute .pptx path to write. Optional; defaults to ~/Downloads/<title>.pptx (or CWD).

spec.description: Deck spec as a JSON object or JSON string: {deck:{wordmark,footLeft,pageLabel}, slides:[{layout, ...}]}. See the agent docstring for each layout's fields; {h}...{/h} highlights a headline span.
